jobs.name: 01-fox-trader
jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the edit target: preserve this exact animal character, pose, broad proportions, accessory, circular base, camera angle, framing and white background. Convert the entire figurine, INCLUDING eyes, pupils, nose, clothes, accessory and base, to ONE uniform light neutral-gray matte resin material, as an unpainted single-material 3D printed sculpture. This must not merely be a grayscale photograph: eliminate every painted dark/light color patch and every contrasting material. No black eyes or white eyes, no painted highlights, no separate metallic parts. Express the friendly eyes and face using simple shallow sculpted relief and recesses in the SAME gray material; all visible tonal differences must come only from lighting on geometry. Retain bold geometric recognition features. Smooth solid surfaces with no simulated print layer lines. Keep accessories thick and joined to body, feet joined to the attached circular pedestal, whole sculpture as a visually continuous one-piece form. White seamless background, soft directional studio light revealing the relief, faint contact shadow. One complete single figure only, no text, no annotations, no extra views. Reference for image-to-3D modeling; conceptual base diameter 30 mm, flat underside, no tag visible. Preserve the overall existing geometry except small relief adjustments necessary for a single-color face.

Preserve the fox ears, muzzle, thick tail resting on the base, short jacket and tablet held against belly. Inner ears may be shallow inset shapes, eyes simple sculpted ovals; nose and tablet also same matte gray.
